How it works

From first call to first session

1

Free intro call

A free call to talk through what's needed. If it's a good fit, you book a block. There's no obligation to continue after the call.

2

Pay for a block of five

Blocks of five are paid upfront, before the sessions begin.

3

Book your session times

After paying, you book all five sessions, ideally the same day and time each week. You get a Google Meet link before the first session.

Policies

Payment, rescheduling and refunds

Payment
Blocks of five are paid upfront, before the sessions begin.
Rescheduling
Let me know as early as possible and we'll find another time within the same block.
Cancelling before a block starts
Cancel before a block starts for a full refund.
Once a block is underway
Any sessions not yet taken are refunded. Sessions already delivered are not.
After the free intro call
No obligation. You only book a block if it's a good fit.
